title: Agent Hooks — verdict
description: Interceptor return value (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §5). Extracted from ACS verdict.schema.json; replaces $policy_target with $target (alias accepted) and reserves host_error:* for host-synthesized reasons.

reason.description: Interceptor-supplied machine identifier. The host_error: prefix is reserved for host-synthesized failures (§11).

result_labels.description: Interceptor-supplied labels the host MUST persist with the produced data and resurface on later interception points (§5.4).

allOf.description: transform body REQUIRED iff decision == transform (§5).

path.description: JSONPath rooted at $target (§5.2). $policy_target is a deprecated alias accepted through agent-hooks v0.2.

artefact.description: Content address (sha256:<hex>) or URI of an offline-verifiable proof.

verification_pointers.description: Named URIs an auditor MAY consult. Hosts MUST NOT dereference automatically (§14).
